top: **19 documentation URLs that agents actually requested return 404 right now** (re-verified live for this report, not taken from the audit) — **the same 19 as on 2026-08-23; none have been fixed**. Agents reach a real endpoint in the OpenAPI spec, construct the matching doc URL, and hit nothing. Several have obvious redirect targets; a few are shipped endpoints with no doc page at all.

**Re-run the API Performance evals.** None have run since 2026-08-23, so the CLI defects, the REST/CLI pass rates and every agent-behaviour pattern in this report are carried over from then. Most of the work that shipped since is unmeasured against real agents — a re-run is what turns "shipped" into "verified".
findings: **The MCP servers are now discoverable.** A server card at `/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json` passes Cloudflare, and Ora detects the server at `mcp.aisa.one` (5/6). What remains is polish: the card itself is incomplete (missing fields: name, description, version (drift: card lists 7 tools the live server does not have: list_categories, account, search, ...)), and no verified MCP registry listing.

**Coding agents are measured for _usage_ but not for _recommendation_.** API Performance and Devtool Arena both run Claude Code against the API (grade C, 69%), but visibility tracking uses only 3 platforms (Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, ChatGPT), **none of them coding agents**, out of 20 available. We know how well Claude Code *uses* AIsa once it arrives, and nothing about whether it ever *recommends* it.

**Nothing shipped since 2026-08-23 has been tested against agents.** Lightsage's API Performance evals have not run since then, so the pass rates, CLI defects and behaviour patterns below are carried over unchanged. Re-running them is the cheapest way to confirm the fixes and re-rank what is left.

**Agent Analytics was switched off as of 2026-08-23.** Lightsage reported no tracking events received, so the inside-out view — which pages agents actually read — did not exist. The public API does not expose this, so confirm in the Lightsage dashboard whether the middleware has since been installed.
**Average position (1.33, #5) rests on 5 citations.** Too few to read as category strength — it will move sharply as citations accumulate.
